title: AudioQuest Factory Tour | On the Road - pt.AUDIO
snippet: AudioQuest was started by Bill Low in the late 1970s and early 1980s. Besides cables and power solutions, AudioQuest has developed other products including phono cartridges in the 1980s (they discontinued production in 1987), headphones, and a variety of vibration isolators, wall outlets, record cleaning brushes, and more. They are constantly innovating and exploring opportunities in audio. [...] When folks ask me about cables, I definitively tell them, “Cables make a difference.” You just need to take the time to hear a good demonstration. Speaking of demonstrations, Bill started his cable demonstrations with a simple cheap boom box back in the 1980s and swapped out the cheap wire it came with to progressively higher-quality AudioQuest cables. Bill doesn’t do those demonstrations any longer, but AudioQuest is still one of the premier cable manufacturers looking to continually improve [...] AudioQuest probably has one of the longest histories of any current hifi cable manufacturer. Before Bill Low started AudioQuest, he was a hi-fi dealer. He hated the lamp cord and cheap 22awg RadioShack cable offerings folks were using for speaker wires back then, so he included higher gauge wire with all the speakers he sold.
